newsitem.title: FRANCE: France raises 1996 sugar beet crop estimate.
newsitem.headline: France raises 1996 sugar beet crop estimate.

text.p: The French farm ministry said on Friday it raised its estimate for the 1996 sugar beet crop to 30.083 million tonnes from a previous target of 29.627 million.
This would represent a decline of 1.6 percent over the 30.571 million tonnes produced in 1995.
The ministry's statistical office SCEES raised its estimate of the beet yield to 66.0 tonnes per hectare from 65.1 tonnes last month. This would compare with a beet yield of 66.9 tonnes in 1995.
The ministry kept its estimate of 1996 plantings unchanged at 456,000 hectares, against 467,000 in 1995.
Sugar content was revised up to 18 percent from last month's estimate of 17.4 percent and the 17.5 percent reached last year.
